name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must pick up the key at least once." (Existence(has_key)) is redundant because the combination of the hard Existence(at_goal) and the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) already forces has_key to occur before the goal. Remove the redundant Existence(has_key) and keep the other two clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must pick up the key at least once." (Existence(has_key)) is redundant. Because the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) together with the hard Existence(at_goal) already forces the agent to acquire the key before reaching the goal (the environment requires the door to be opened with the key, and reaching the goal requires the door to be open). Remove the hard Existence(has_key) clause; keep Existence(at_goal) hard and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard.

texts: The agent must pick up the key at least once.
The agent must reach the goal at least once.
Reaching the goal must occur after picking up the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:

REJECTING_STATES: u2

REWARD_FUNCTION:
